method: Actual Next.js application, isolated synthetic PGlite database and CUA browser interactions; no mocked business responses.

390×844: single-column fields; header, tabs and footer inside viewport; no horizontal overflow.
320×568: title wraps beside close control; Cancel, Save draft and Review remain within dialog bounds after footer correction.
Existing driver resolves to name/email/current role; branch shown as Lagos.
Inactive account produces explicit error and cannot be selected.
Own account produces self-access error and cannot be selected.
Cancel opens discard guard; Keep editing retains reason; Discard closes.
Review draft followed by separate Save draft creates inactive request; API confirms role unchanged.
Payment Wallet field survives navigation to Fees and Review; arrow-key navigation selects/focuses correct tab.
Explicit Review stays open with a separate confirmation; API confirms final review-only nonces absent from requests.
1800.29 naira displays ₦1,800.29 and saves as exactly 180029 kobo.
Server REAUTH_REQUIRED reveals/focuses password only on review; wrong password retains edits; valid retry saves once.
Missing reason focuses native validation and does not enter review.
Offer editing stays expanded while title changes; review from Points reveals Offers and focuses missing Offer code.
No hosted mutations in browser. All write/exception acceptance uses disposable loopback database.
With the actual client-demo notice enabled locally, footer ends above the notice with at least 12px clearance at 1280x720,390x844 and320x568; all footer buttons remain inside the dialog.
